fusions.name: Heaved Spoil
fusions.desc: Flings a clod from the tines that deals 13 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Overturn
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Turns the earth in a ring that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pit and Cover
fusions.desc: Digs a pit by the nearest enemy that waits for up to 45 seconds. The first enemy to come within 3 tiles springs it, dealing 22 damage to everything within 2 tiles and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Heaped Bank
fusions.desc: When you strike, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
